profile.headline: SWE at iDentalSoft | M.S. Data Science @ UCR
profile.summary:
Hi, my name is Matti!

Software Engineer at iDentalSoft, building across the full stack for a dental PMS. Currently developing our mobile app and working on system design and feature implementation. On the backend, I built a full RAG pipeline with a web scraping layer to power our internal knowledge base.

My background spans management information systems, data science, and information security, including a Master's degree in Data Science. Focused on growing as an engineer and taking on increasingly complex technical challenges.


contact: mattinguyen12@gmail.com

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building production features and R&D initiatives across iDS. Stack spans Flutter mobile, LLM/RAG systems, voice AI, and AWS Bedrock pipelines.

iMobile (Flutter mobile app)
- Core screens: iChat (paginated SMS with photo loading and reverse scroll), Patients List (cursor pagination, debounced search, lazy photo cache), tabbed Patient Profile, dual mode Scheduling calendar (Chair/Provider with working-hours overlay and medical-alert rendering), iFax, iVoice with dialer, and Patient Notes with signature canvas.
- Architecture: dedicated service layer for chat, patients, and scheduling; TapGuard debounce utility, Face ID login, and Firestore listener + FCM handler for live in-app chat sync.
- Payments: Worldpay Hosted Payments via REST/XML → TransactionSetupID → WebView, with SoftPOS.

RAG Chatbot: Built an internal knowledge assistant answering questions from the company's online documentation. 
- Pipeline: Selenium scraper -> HuggingFace embeddings -> ChromaDB ->ensemble retriever combining BM25, semantic search, self-query (metadata filtered), and multiquery with parallel batch retrieval -> LLM. Serving dental practices at ~30 queries/day (3,000+ answered, ~3s end to end).

iFormalizer: Built a note reformatting tool layered on the RAG stack; converts free-form clinical notes into SOAP, DAP, or standard formats. 

R&D / Proof of Concept:
- AI Dental Receptionist: Conversational AI voice agent using ElevenLabs.
- iEOB: Automated Explanation of Benefits claim reconciliation via AWS Bedrock with prompt engineered structured JSON output.
- iPerio: Perio chart entry powered by Vosk speech recognition.

• Delivered weekly, in-depth presentations to project managers, showcasing the latest project milestones and deliverables

positions.title: Analyst Internship
positions.description:
Enhanced iDentalsoft's customer satisfaction and operational efficiency through technical support, project management, and website revamp.

• Supported the creation and routine update and maintenance of an Excel-based monthly income reporting for iDentalsoft from Twilio.
• Served as primary contact of customers on help desk ticketing system, improving customer satisfaction with responsive customer support. 
• Prioritized customer experience while providing product/service-related assistance and ensuring timely resolution of customer issues.
• Played an instrumental role in migrating the existing website to a new Wiki domain and revamping website with a user-friendly interface.
• Reviewed and ensured compatibility of x-rays and sensors with iDentalsoft and drove technical documentation with descriptive references.

projects.title: GMO Detective Interactive Chatbot
projects.description: Crafted an AI GMO Chatbot using IBM Watson, employing intents, entities, and dialogue nodes to accurately identify and convey produced information from barcode scans. This solution integrates detailed datasets on food properties, ensuring precise GMO analysis and origin tracking
